text: Abstract composition, Bauhaus style. First a faint black background rectangle, 780 by 480, centred, named Canvas.
huge red circle in the center, call it Disc
a large blue square to the left of Disc, named Block
and a large yellow triangle on the right of Disc, Peak
align Block, Disc and Peak horizontally
A long navy rectangle, 400 by 20, under Disc, named Bar
five small black circles in a row above Disc
make them gray
space those circles out evenly
Put a white diamond between Block and Disc
another white diamond between Disc and Peak
make both diamonds small
connect the two diamonds with a black line
teal hexagon in the top left corner, name it Hex
and a magenta hexagon in the bottom right corner, Hex2
make Hex huge
now Hex2 the same size as Hex
dotted line from Hex to Hex2
Six tiny gold stars in a ring in the top right
is Peak right of Disc?
Which shape is the biggest now, the hexagon?
make Disc a little smaller
bring Disc in front of everything
group Block, Disc and Peak as Trio
move Trio up 30
Write "FORM / COLOUR" in the bottom left in large black letters
hmm, the text should be gray
turn Block into a circle
No, back to a square, undo
How many hexagons are there?
which shapes are white at this point?
arrange the stars in a row
put Bar 20 px below Trio
Is Bar below Disc?
make all the circles purple, even Disc
undo that, only the five small circles should be purple
Are there any triangles?
duplicate Peak
make the copy pink and small
what's the rightmost shape?
Is diamond1 left of diamond2?
delete the copy
Done, very Bauhaus.
